title: Human vs. Machine: Behavioral Differences between Expert Humans and Language Models in Wargame Simulations

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the frequency of aggressive versus de-escalatory strategic actions chosen by LLMs compared to human experts in a multi-turn military wargame simulation.
Altering the distributions of simulated player backgrounds (e.g., gender, age, professional background) in the LLM prompts to measure whether the model's strategic decisions change.

Instructing the LLM to simulate teams with extreme personality traits, such as 'strict pacifists' or 'aggressive sociopaths', to evaluate if the model adjusts its simulated wargame decisions accordingly.
